description: Estimate a Class I carload rail freight rate for a commodity, distance, and weight. Pass origin and destination to check for active freight track near both ends (USDOT rail network): rail_access names the railroads nearby, and a lane with no track within 50 miles of an end returns available: false with the reason instead of a price. Don't quote rail on such a lane. Returns a directional benchmark for planning. Each call counts as one estimate toward the account's monthly FreightFA allowance.

destination.description: Destination city or ZIP, e.g. 'Atlanta, GA'. Recommended: enables the rail access check.

distance.description: Lane distance in miles. recommend_mode returns it for a city or ZIP pair.

origin.description: Origin city or ZIP, e.g. 'Kansas City, MO'. Recommended: enables the rail access check.

name: estimate_rail_rate
title: Estimate rail rate
